records.title: groupby로 월별 매출 집계하기
records.subject: Pandas
codeBlocks:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("sales.csv", parse_dates=["날짜"])

# 월별 매출 집계
monthly = (
    df.groupby(df["날짜"].dt.to_period("M"))["매출"]
    .sum()
    .reset_index()
)
print(monthly.head())
